- Next recommended step: technical architecture review / demo with our Private deployment engineers to walk through network diagrams, authentication, and onboarding timeline.

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Wed Aug 5, 10:00–11:00
- Thu Aug 6, 09:00–10:00
- Thu Aug 6, 14:00–15:00

Agenda (attached):
1) 15m - intro & goals
2) 30m - VPC peering & networking (Dev)
3) 10m - security & KMS (Jonas)
4) 5m - next steps / action items

Can you confirm which slot works — or share a couple of times that fit your team? I cc'd Dev (solutions engineer) and Jonas (sales lead) who will join the deep dive.

Thanks,
